text.title: 农场门上的地图
text.situation:
周六，林和玛雅乘早班公交去给河街集市供货的一座农场。大门上的地图标着田地、谷仓和小店。篱笆那边，一辆拖拉机缓缓驶过一片农业用地。林能看见远处地平线上的城镇新楼，不过这里最先传来的声音是发动机和鸟鸣。

农夫：农业是我们的工作，不过每块田有不同用途。这种作物是作为食物种的，那块小田用来试验。
林：土看起来很黑。
农夫：它很肥沃，不过仅凭颜色不能看出全部。种植前我们会检查。栽培开始的时间，远比你看到一片绿色的田地要早。

田间参访
拖拉机工作时，请跟着农夫走。使用篱笆旁的小路。参访后在大门集合；农场小店在谷仓另一侧。

paragraphs.en: On Saturday, Lin and Maya took the early bus to a farm that supplied the River Street market. A map on the gate showed fields, a barn and a small shop. Beyond the fence, a tractor moved slowly across a strip of agricultural land. Lin could see the town’s new buildings on the far horizon, but here the first sounds were an engine and birds.

paragraphs.en:
Farmer: Agriculture is our work, but each field has a different job. This crop is grown for food. That smaller plot is for a trial.
Lin: The soil looks dark.
Farmer: It’s fertile, though the colour alone can’t tell you everything. We check it before planting. Cultivation starts long before you see a field of green.

paragraphs.en:
Field visit
Please stay with the farmer while the tractor is working. Use the path beside the fence. Meet at the gate after the visit; the farm shop is on the other side of the barn.

S09.F01.P01.function: A map on the farm gate
S09.F01.P01.cue: 告诉朋友农夫做什么，以及田里种了什么。
acceptableAnswers: 农夫从事农业。这种作物是作为食物种的。

S09.F01.P02.function: A map on the farm gate
S09.F01.P02.cue: 描述车辆及它驶过的土地用途。
acceptableAnswers: 一辆拖拉机驶过一片农业用地。

S09.F01.P03.function: A map on the farm gate
S09.F01.P03.cue: 说明农夫种植前为什么检查土壤。
acceptableAnswers: 土壤要肥沃。检查土壤是栽培准备的一部分。

S09.F01.T01.function: A map on the farm gate
S09.F01.T01.cue: 你介绍一块社区种植地。说明种植内容和土壤条件。
acceptableAnswers: 这里种一种食用作物，土壤很肥沃。
